description: Condense any input (brief, PRD, transcript, brain dump, design folder, or several sources at once) into a short SPEC.md plus supporting files that later work builds from. Pins down what to build before deciding how. Works for software, game design, research, editorial, policy, business — anything with an intent behind it. Can also validate an existing spec.

Amazon's Working Backwards method: write the press release for the finished product first, then answer hard customer and stakeholder questions to test whether the concept holds up. An alternative to the product brief.
Guided walkthrough of a change, from purpose and context into details. Use for human review of commits, branches, or PRs.
Use early in ideation or when stuck generating ideas.
Orchestrate multi-agent discussions when you need multiple perspectives or want agents to collaborate.

Use when you want to change how an agent or workflow behaves — add persistent facts, swap templates, insert activation hooks, or customize menus. Scans what's customizable, picks the right scope (agent vs workflow), writes the override to _mm/custom/, and verifies the merge. No TOML hand-authoring required.

Use at any checkpoint to push a just-produced draft, section, or plan past its first version — pick from a menu of elicitation methods (pre-mortem, first principles, red team, socratic) and apply the improvements.

Review anything before it ships: a diff, branch, or uncommitted changes; a PRD, spec, story, or architecture document; any prose. Applies whichever installed review methods (lenses) fit the content — shipped ones cover adversarial critique, edge cases, verification gaps, document structure, and prose editing — or exactly the ones you name. Code Review in other modules calls it automatically.

Test an idea — software, business, creative, research, or personal — through probing questions from different personas until you can act on it or drop it with confidence. Can hand the result to mm-spec or mm-quick-dev.
Facilitate game brainstorming sessions with game-specific context and techniques.
Game industry domain deep dive subject matter expertise and terminology.
Interactive game brief creation that guides users through defining their game vision.
Create, update, or validate a game's GDD — the primary design artifact covering pillars, mechanics, progression, levels, art, audio, and development epics.
Create comprehensive narrative documentation including story structure character arcs and world-building. Use for story-driven games.
Plan game UX with DESIGN.md and EXPERIENCE.md spines covering UI, HUD, input schemes, and player journeys.
Create, update, or validate a game project's PRD — often derived from a GDD or prepared for external-tool integration.
Create optimized project-context.md for chosen agentic tool consistency.
Produce a scale-adaptive game architecture with engine systems networking and technical design.
Create the Epics and Stories listing from GDD requirements. These are the specs that drive development.
Ensure GDD UX Architecture and Epics Stories are aligned before production begins.
Initialize game test framework architecture for Unity Unreal Engine or Godot projects.
Create comprehensive game test scenarios covering gameplay progression and quality requirements.
Generate or update sprint-status.yaml from epic files.
View sprint progress surface risks and get next action recommendation.
Create Story with comprehensive context for developer agent implementation.
Execute Dev Story workflow implementing tasks and tests.
Perform thorough clean context QA code review on stories flagged Ready for Review.
Facilitate team retrospective after a game development epic is completed.
Forensic case investigation with evidence-graded findings — trace a bug, reconstruct an incident, or model unfamiliar code.
Analyze an existing game project to produce useful documentation.
Clarify plan implement review and present any user intent or change request in a single workflow.
Navigate significant changes during game dev sprint when implementation is off-track.
Generate automated game tests.
Scaffold E2E testing infrastructure.
Create structured playtesting plan.
Design performance testing strategy.
Review test quality and coverage.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Game designer for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively when the user wants to shape mechanics, core loops, progression or rules, wants balancing proposals, or asks to draft or edit the GDD. Writes design drafts and GDD changes, not code.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Level designer for MonkeyMode projects. Use when the user wants a level, map, arena or encounter laid out, pacing planned across a level or campaign, or a blockout spec a programmer or artist can build from.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Gameplay programmer for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively to implement a story or gameplay feature in the configured engine (Godot, Unity, Unreal, Bevy or other), fix gameplay bugs, or wire up mechanics from the GDD. Writes code and tests and verifies them.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Read-only code reviewer for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively after code changes, or when the user asks for a review, to check a diff against the project guardrails, engine rules and the story's acceptance criteria. Reports findings; never edits.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). QA tester for MonkeyMode projects. Use when tests need writing or running, a bug needs reproducing and narrowing down, or the user wants a playtest or regression checklist. Writes tests and repro steps; does not change game code beyond tests.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Performance profiler for MonkeyMode projects. Use when the game stutters, drops frames, loads slowly, uses too much memory or the user asks about performance budgets. Measures first, then proposes fixes with before and after numbers.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Network engineer for MonkeyMode multiplayer projects. Use for server authority design, replication and state sync, RPC validation, lag compensation, and debugging desyncs or rubber-banding. Tests with several connected instances.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Technical artist for MonkeyMode projects. Use for shaders, VFX, materials, asset import settings, LODs, texture budgets and the Blender to engine pipeline. Uses the mm-art-tools Blender and GPU capture skills when installed.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). UI and UX designer for MonkeyMode projects. Use for HUD and menu layout, screen flows, input mapping and controller support, onboarding, and accessibility (text size, color contrast, remapping, subtitles).

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Narrative writer for MonkeyMode projects. Use for story, characters, dialogue, quests, item and lore text, and for checking new writing against the existing lore and narrative docs.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Audio designer for MonkeyMode projects. Use for sound effect and music specs, audio event lists, implementation notes for the engine or middleware, and mixing and loudness checklists.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Economy and progression balancer for MonkeyMode projects. Use for currencies, sinks and sources, XP curves, drop tables, crafting costs and pricing; builds spreadsheets or small simulations to back every number.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Build and release engineer for MonkeyMode projects. Use for build scripts, CI pipelines, platform packaging and signing, version numbers, and store submission checklists (Steam, consoles, mobile stores, web).

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Localization engineer for MonkeyMode projects. Use for extracting hard-coded strings, setting up string tables, the translation workflow, plurals and formatting, and font, text overflow and right-to-left layout checks.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Read-only guardrail auditor for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively before a commit or release, or when the user asks whether the project is safe, to scan for guardrail violations, banned APIs, secrets and personal paths, and explain each fix in plain language.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-agents). Docs writer for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively at the end of a task or session to bring docs/project up to date with approved decisions, write the handoff in docs/work, and keep the pointer file current.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-godot). Godot 4 specialist for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively for Godot 4-specific work: GDScript or C#, scenes and nodes, signals, autoloads, Resources, the high-level multiplayer API and headless tests. Also use when an engine error, crash or editor behavior needs an expert explanation.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-unity). Unity specialist for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively for Unity-specific work: C#, assemblies, MonoBehaviours, ScriptableObjects, the asset pipeline, Mirror or Netcode for GameObjects, and batch-mode builds and tests. Also use when an engine error, crash or editor behavior needs an expert explanation.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-unreal). Unreal Engine 5 specialist for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively for Unreal Engine 5-specific work: C++ and Blueprints, UObject lifetime and garbage collection, the Gameplay Framework, replication and RPCs, UBT builds and automation tests. Also use when an engine error, crash or editor behavior needs an expert explanation.

Claude Code subagent (plugin mm-bevy). Bevy specialist for MonkeyMode projects. Use proactively for Bevy-specific work: Rust and ECS: systems, components, resources, schedules, plugins, states, lightyear, replicon or renet, and cargo tests. Also use when an engine error, crash or editor behavior needs an expert explanation.
